questions.subject: INTEGRATED_3
questions.learningObjective: compute the slope of a line from two points
questions.stem: A wheelchair ramp rises 2 metres over 8 metres horizontally. What is the slope?

options.misconception: confuses "4 (inverts rise and run)" with the correct "1/4 (rise over run)"
uses the rise as the slope
uses the run as the slope

questions.explanation: Slope is rise over run: 2/8 = 1/4. The ramp climbs one metre for every four metres of horizontal distance.

questions.stem: A ramp rises 5 metres over a horizontal distance of 10 metres. What is its slope?

options.misconception: selects "7 (absolute constant)" instead of "3 (coefficient of x)"

questions.explanation: Slope is rise over run: 5/10 = 1/2. Each two metres of horizontal travel gains one metre of height.
questions.hint: Slope is the coefficient of x.
